notes.title: Small Update #5 - 2023/9/2
notes.content:
[h1]Map collision cause player fall[/h1]
Many players say that they find some different situations in the map that character can fall out of the map. We have fixed every map collision problems after receiving related feedback. Today's fix is mainly about phase 14 to phase 17.

[h1]Fixed enemy fly on the wall bug[/h1]
Some flying enemies in between phase 14 to 17 could spawn on the edge of the map that they stay on the wall and cant be killed. Today's update made the spawn area more centered so that enemies won't spawn on the edge.

notes.title: Important GPU performance tips
notes.content:
Today I have received some feedback from players claiming that they have low FPS during the game.

This update has made some improvement on performance, to further increase FPS, you can go to settings menu in game and do the following things:
[olist]
[*] Set Full Screen Mode
[*] Set Resolution Scale to 1/2
[*] Set Overall quality to high
[/olist]

These settings will improve your FPS with very low visual effect loss.
Hope you enjoy the game.
